rules.description: Strictly enforce historical deletion average threshold of 0.1%
Verify MaxDate is within allowable publication lag and values are non-negative (and within [0, 100] for rates) for active recurring indicators

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT IN ('Count_Person_100To104Years', 'Count_Person_100To104Years_Male', 'Count_Person_100To104Years_Female', 'Count_Person_105To109Years', 'Count_Person_105To109Years_Male', 'Count_Person_105To109Years_Female', 'Count_Person_110OrMoreYears', 'Count_Person_110OrMoreYears_Male', 'Count_Person_110OrMoreYears_Female')
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 5) AND total_svs >= 92 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0 AND (StatVar != 'UnemploymentRate_Person' OR MaxValue <= 100)

rules.description: Verify MaxDate is at least the last published census wave (2020) and values are non-negative for discontinued historical centenarian sub-brackets

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_Person_100To104Years', 'Count_Person_100To104Years_Male', 'Count_Person_100To104Years_Female', 'Count_Person_105To109Years', 'Count_Person_105To109Years_Male', 'Count_Person_105To109Years_Female', 'Count_Person_110OrMoreYears', 'Count_Person_110OrMoreYears_Male', 'Count_Person_110OrMoreYears_Female')
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2020 AND total_svs >= 9 AND MinValue >= 0
